# Footage — Private On-Device AI Photo Curator for Android

> Footage is an Android photo app developed by Shivayu Consultants. It is designed to solve the universal frustration of post-vacation gallery overwhelm by automatically surfacing your best takes, pre-sorting photo clutter for 1-tap deletion, and keeping 100% of your personal photos strictly on your phone.

## Primary Value Proposition
"Too many takes. One photo worth posting."
Instead of spending 45 minutes manually comparing burst shots from a vacation, event, or dinner, Footage uses on-device neural vision to find the standout take in seconds, and pre-sorts blurry or closed-eye duplicates so you can purge gigabytes in a single tap.

## The Problem We Solve (WHY)
- **Post-Vacation Overwhelm:** People take 500+ photos on trips but dread manually scrolling past hundreds of duplicate bursts, blurs, and closed eyes to find the 5 photos they actually want to post or edit.
- **Gallery Stress:** Zooming into 15 near-identical burst shots to find the single frame where no one blinked wastes time and drains the joy out of capturing memories.
- **Paying for Digital Clutter:** Cloud storage providers charge users recurring monthly fees to store thousands of low-quality duplicate photos they will never view again.

## Our Approach (HOW)
- **Shoot → Footage → Post & Clean:** Capture freely without worrying about picking the winner in the moment. Footage scans locally and surfaces the golden takes.
- **100% On-Device Local Processing:** Uses local LiteRT and ML Kit hardware acceleration on mobile NPUs/GPUs. Zero photos, metadata, or face biometrics leave the device.
- **Pre-Sorted Storage Recovery:** Organizes bad shots, blurs, and duplicates into clean-up bins for instant 1-tap removal.

## Product Capabilities & Trust (WHAT)
- **Instant Best Take Selection:** Rates lighting, focus, composition, and expressions to highlight standout shots from any trip or event.
- **Effortless 1-Tap Cleanup:** Reclaim gigabytes of device storage when space gets tight without risking favorite photos.
- **Cloud Storage & Fee Saver:** Cuts down cloud storage tier upgrade costs (Google Photos / iCloud) by preventing photo clutter from auto-syncing.
- **100% Free Forever by Shivayu Consultants:** Zero ads, zero trackers, zero subscriptions, zero in-app purchases, and 100% offline privacy.
